sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; the baked payload is only the fallback when the tab is unreadable (never splice null). R35: optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series from the tab's Discount % column. R36: optional nrEro / cbEro / wtyEro series (dollars, positive = loss; blank → 0; all three to BOTH trades or to neither) from the Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty Erosion columns — the Trends Erosion section hides when a payload lacks them

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R36 (2026-07-30): Non-Revenue & Erosion. (1) deptOfBU goes three-way — Non-Revenue = the Misc Service + Indirect BUs, carved OUT of Service; the Summary dept card gains the third column and Service + Install + Non-Revenue still reconciles to the P&L job-attributed labor and purchases. (2) New Summary card 'Non-Revenue · Callback · Warranty — Cost & Erosion': Callback/Warranty match on JOB TYPE across every BU (ILIKE callback / warranty, per the KPI map), Non-Revenue = Misc/Indirect BUs excluding those job types — disjoint buckets; cost = job labor + job purchases + revenue-share invBurn − revenue-share rebate; Erosion = cost − revenue; % Loss = erosion ÷ scope net revenue. (3) Trends Erosion section (Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty / Total $ + % of revenue, g:-1, nosm, MTD-Pace aware via paceVals) fed by the optional SAGEH nrEro/cbEro/wtyEro keys; hardening: rawSeries null-guards absent series, the insights smoothing loop honors live(), and Trends group headers emit lazily so an all-hidden section leaves no dangling header (all three no-ops on R35-shaped payloads). Verified 2026-07-30 jsdom A/B vs R35 on the July 07/01-07/29 exports (3,689 jobs, $5,427,932, gates 6/6 both builds, builtAt equalized): every pre-existing summary key identical in all three scopes, Trends innerHTML byte-identical across both anchors and all scopes, RAW identical; dept split reconciles (A.Svc = B.Svc + B.NR exactly; Svc+Inst+NR labor = jobLabor); erosion buckets disjoint and Tot = sum; synthetic-payload forward test renders all 5 rows in all 6 combos with the pace column reconciling exactly. Parsers, job-level math, GM/CP, flags, accrual, Handoff and review machinery untouched — June invariants unaffected. build.js and close.js run VERBATIM.
